findings.title: Timeline Add to chat does nothing for thread comments the host leaves out of `detail.comments`
findings.body: The timeline handler looks the clicked id up in `detail.comments` only and silently does nothing when it finds no match. `pullRequestConversationItems` notes that "some hosts only include a comment in the thread" and builds a normalized copy for those comments (pullRequestDetail.logic.ts:564-575). The timeline renders that copy, and `commentTimelineEvent` gives it a `body`, so the button appears (line 272). Clicking it then finds nothing: no chip and no toast. The event already carries `comment` (pullRequestDetail.logic.ts:522). Pass `event.comment` to the callback instead of re-finding it by id. `addCommentToChat` already maps a comment to its review thread.

findings.title: Pull request reference dedupe matches on number, not URL
findings.body: `hasPullRequest` compares only `existing.pullRequest?.number === detail.number`. `buildPullRequestReferenceContext` keys on the URL because "repositories can share pull request numbers" (pullRequestDetail.logic.ts:1138-1139), and `pullRequest.url` is stored on the chip (pullRequestDetail.logic.ts:1124). Suppose the composer already holds a reference to repo A's #42 and the reader adds a remark from repo B's #42. The repo B reference, which carries the untrusted-data notice, is skipped, so the agent reads the remark against the wrong pull request with no visible sign. Compare `existing.pullRequest?.url === detail.url` instead.

contracts.action: Add to chat on a review thread or remark puts a PR reference chip (if missing) and a `pr-comment:` chip into the composer beside the panel
contracts.equivalent_path: Composer drag-drop of a pull request (ChatComposer.tsx:2606-2615) and the fix hand-off's writeTaskToComposer (PullRequestDetailPanel.tsx:785-788)
contracts.before_after: The drag path builds the reference with buildPullRequestReferenceContext and calls addReviewComment. The store skips the reference when the same id is already present and replaces the entry by id (composerDraftStore.ts:3760-3774). The new path does the same, but it decides whether a PR reference already exists by number only, not by the URL the reference id uses.
contracts.visible_effect: The chips and inline references appear in the composer through the store's insertion handler, and a success toast is shown.
contracts.failure_mode: Synchronous, so there is no async failure. A null context (no words) returns silently. A missed timeline lookup also returns silently (see finding).

contracts.action: Timeline Add to chat maps an event id back to a PullRequestComment
contracts.equivalent_path: pullRequestConversationItems normalizes thread comments missing from detail.comments
contracts.before_after: The timeline events include thread-only comments (logic.ts:564-575), but the lookup searches only detail.comments.
contracts.visible_effect: On hosts that leave thread comments out of detail.comments, the button shows but clicking it does nothing.

summary:
This change adds an "Add to chat" action to the Summary, Code and Timeline tabs of the pull request panel. It brings a review conversation or remark into the composer beside the panel as its own chip, plus one PR reference chip, and makes no hand-off. The new `readableBody` function strips HTML-comment bookkeeping but keeps code fences, and the tests cover that well. Two problems:
- **Timeline lookup.** The Timeline tab looks the clicked comment up only in `detail.comments`. Some hosts include a comment only in its thread, so on those hosts the button shows but clicking it does nothing.
- **Reference dedupe.** The check for an existing PR reference compares the pull request number, not its URL. Two repositories can have a #42, so a remark from the second one can land without its own PR context.
